newsitem.title: TURKEY: Iraqi Kurd leader says Baghdad attacks continue.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi Kurd leader says Baghdad attacks continue.

text.p: Iraqi Kurdish leader Jalal Talabani told Reuters Baghdad's forces continued to attack Kurdish positions in northern Iraq on Tuesday despite U.S. air strikes.
Iraqi Kurd leader says Baghdad attacks continue

"Forty Iraqi tanks, as well as artillery, moved from Qushtapa toward Bustaneh about one hour ago. Their advance has been stopped by the peshmerga (guerrilla) resistance," Talabani told Reuters from his stronghold of Sulaymaniya, more than 100 km (60 miles) to the south.

He said the Iraqi troop movements came shortly after 25-30 U.S. cruise missiles were launched against military targets in southern Iraq -- approximately 1000 km (600 miles) away from the Kurdish-held north.

Talabani, whose Patriotic Union of Kurdistan was ousted from the Kurdish city of Arbil by Iraqi forces at the weekend, said he expected further U.S. attacks should Baghdad not withdraw from the area at once.
"This is just the hors d'oeuvre of the conflict," he said of the U.S. strike. "This is not the main course."
